Food photography · Creative brief

麻婆豆腐

Mapo Tofu

Prompt

Premium Chinese restaurant food poster featuring deconstructed layers of 麻婆豆腐 / Mapo Tofu floating in a vertical stack on pure black background. Seven distinct layers from top to bottom, including a large empty gap before the finished dish. Upper layers are RAW, UNCOOKED recipe ingredients; only the final dish at the bottom is cooked.

1) Top layer: dry, unheated reddish-brown Sichuan peppercorns and a small cloud of freshly ground Sichuan pepper powder. Make the peppercorn husks and fine powder visible.

2) Second layer: two distinct small uncooked condiment clusters, reddish-brown fermented chili bean paste (doubanjiang) and glossy dark fermented black beans (douchi), with a few ivory raw garlic slices beside them. These are recipe condiments before frying, with no cooked meat mixed in.

3) Third layer: fresh RAW minced beef in a loose floating mound, showing moist red-pink fine meat strands and a few tiny white fat flecks. The beef must be clearly uncooked and unseasoned, not brown, fried, crumbly cooked mince or covered with red sauce.

4) Fourth layer: a generous group of pristine fresh tofu cubes, smooth opaque ivory-white with clean straight cut edges and delicate soft texture, accompanied by a few fresh green scallion rings. The tofu is shown before blanching or simmering; no seared surfaces, curry coating or red sauce.

5) Fifth layer: a transparent glass bowl filled with plain clear water used to simmer the tofu and make the sauce. Show realistic water refraction and glass reflections, without colored broth, chili oil, cooked sauce or steam.

6) Sixth layer: EMPTY SPACE - a large gap with a few tiny Sichuan pepper particles drifting through it. Subtle steam rises here only from the finished bowl below.

7) Bottom/Final layer: a complete cooked 麻婆豆腐 / Mapo Tofu in a dark brown ceramic bowl. Tender ivory tofu cubes sit in a glossy vivid red Sichuan chili-bean sauce with browned cooked minced beef, tiny fermented black beans and a sheen of red chili oil. Fine Sichuan pepper powder and bright green scallion rings finish the dish. The tofu remains soft and identifiable, generously surrounded by moderately thick sauce. Subtle steam rises from the bowl. No chicken pieces, potatoes, noodles, coconut milk or unrelated garnish.

Chinese and English annotation pairs, in ingredient order:
"花椒" / "Sichuan Pepper"
"豆瓣酱与豆豉" / "Chili Bean Paste & Black Beans"
"生牛肉末" / "Raw Minced Beef"
"豆腐与葱花" / "Tofu & Scallions"
"清水" / "Water"
"成品" / "Finished Dish"

Each of the five ingredient layers floats freely with normal spacing. After the fifth layer, leave an intentional empty transition space two to three times larger than an ordinary gap. At the bottom, reveal the complete cooked dish in a traditional dark brown ceramic bowl. Use the same 45-degree camera angle and consistent scale and dramatic studio lighting throughout. All upper ingredient layers must look RAW or UNCOOKED AS USED BEFORE THIS RECIPE IS COOKED: plain pink meat, fresh crisp vegetables, unheated condiments and spices, and uncooked noodles where specified. No cooked crust, browned meat, stir-fried vegetables, finished meat sauce, or steam in the upper layers. Fermented pastes and tofu are shown as recipe ingredients before pan cooking.

Set everything against pure black (#000000), with warm rim lighting, realistic glass reflections, rich food textures, luxurious commercial restaurant photography and a 9:16 portrait format. Keep the ingredients centered. Place legible warm cream bilingual labels around them, alternating left and right, with thin elegant curved arrows. Chinese appears above English; render only the specified labels, once each, with generous margins and no overlap with food. The empty transition gap has no label. Only the finished dish emits subtle steam, rising into the transition gap. Add a few drifting spice particles appropriate to this dish and a small star sparkle at the bottom right beside the finished bowl. All layers float freely: no table, pedestal, platform, plate under the ingredients, extra title, logo, slogan or unrelated food.
